description: SHAPE: two curves `main[]` and `compare[]` (not `bars` / `items`), rows `{bar_time, avg_pct, stock_count}`, plus `main_pool_size` / `compare_pool_size`. Are yesterday's limit-up buyers making money today? Yesterday's limit-up pool (minus one-word boards and boards that broke and stayed broken), plotted minute by minute today as an **equal-weighted** average percent change; `compare` is the same curve one day earlier. ⚠️ Read `main_pool_size` / `compare_pool_size` with the curves — they tell a premium move from a population change. ⚠️ Equal-weighted, not cap-weighted, so not comparable to index returns. Series use 240 minute end labels (09:31-11:30, 13:01-15:00). Pool dates are trading days, resolved server-side. Empty `main` with a non-zero pool size = session not started. Optional scope filters both pools; omit it to preserve the legacy all_a basket. ETF is excluded.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

scope.description: Stock basket; all_a includes ST, all_a_ex_st excludes ST and newly listed stocks. Defaults to all_a for compatibility.

name: sentiment_premium
